description: Research Experience for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2019: Modeling and Seismic Response of a Steel-framed Composite Diaphragm Structure is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Peter Davis, Stony Brook University (stonybrook.edu). In my NHERI REU experience, I participated in a study that produced experimental data on the behavior of steel collector beams under seismic loads. The experimental specimen consisted of a half-scale steel-framed structure with a composite steel-concrete diaphragm. The specimen was tested using UC San Diego's Large High Performance Outdoor Shake Table. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-2rwn-2409. Keywords: Lateral Stiffness, Fundamental Frequency, White noise, Static pull, seismic response, modeling. Published 2019-09-12. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
